Subject: Re: Trial — quick follow-up on top-up and discount

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — the team liked the throughput and the low-latency examples. Procurement asked whether you could combine a short-term trial extension with additional credits and a modest discount if we commit to an early proof-of-concept. Specifically: 45 days total trial (two-week top-up from your standard 30 days), $30k in platform credits applied during the trial, and a 10% list discount on year-one committed usage if we sign a 12-month reserved capacity agreement within 60 days.

This would materially accelerate our internal evaluation and make budget approvals simpler. Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve this bundle, and if not, what an executive exception process would look like?

Best,
Elena Alvarez
Head of Platform
Aurora Biotech

Team — forwarding request from Aurora. Summary: they want a 45-day trial (standard is 30), $30k in credits during the trial, plus 10% off year-one committed pricing if they sign a 12-month commit within 60 days. HubSpot deal RDW-2026-AUR-47.

Why I’m asking: Aurora is a strategic biotech with multi-region plans and a high probability to move to Dedicated if the POC looks good. They already hit our free-tier usage and are actively evaluating scaling patterns that would be runway for a Dedicated seat. We typically approve small top-ups and token credits, but combined credits + discount crosses our standard promo bands.

Request: Can we approve this as-is, or should we counter (e.g., $20k credits + 7% discount + 45-day trial)? I’ve attached the proposal and draft SOW they’ll sign once pricing is confirmed. If we need exec sign-off, Marissa — can you weigh in?

Attachments: Proposal_Aurora_Trial_Pack.pdf, Aurora_SOW_draft.docx

Thanks,
Kimberly

Subject: Re: FWD: Aurora request — need exec exception for combined offer

Kimberly — thanks for the context. Quick thoughts:

- $30k credits + 10% plus 45-day trial is a fairly aggressive combined concession for an SMB/upper-mid account; for a strategic biotech it's defensible if we have a clear path to a $200k+ ARR committed seat.
- Ask for a measurable gating condition: sign 12-month commit > $150k ARR within 60 days, otherwise credits are converted to pay-as-you-go and the discount voids. That protects us.
- Prefer reducing credits to $25k and keeping 45 days; keep 10% discount but require the commit threshold.

Marcus — can you run this against forecasts and confirm whether a $25k/$150k threshold preserves our unit economics? Marissa — if it looks structurally sound, can you approve an exec exception with those guardrails? If not, Kimberly will need an explicit sign-off for the full ask.

- Aditya
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FWD: Aurora request — need exec exception for combined offer

Checked forecast/ECs — baseline economics: we need ~30% uplift versus current churn/usage assumptions to break even on $30k credits at a 10% discount for year one. If we tighten to $25k credits and a $150k committed ARR threshold, expected ROI is positive with a reasonable margin buffer.

Recommendation: approve the counter (45-day trial, $25k credits, 10% discount conditional on signed 12-month commit >= $150k within 60 days). Add an automated rollback clause in the SOW: if they don't hit the commit, discount rescinded and any unused credits billed at list.

Marissa — this is a conservative guardrail that still wins the deal. Your approval would let Kimberly close the loop with Elena today.

-Marcus
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: RE: FWD: Aurora request — need exec exception for combined offer

Team — I approve the counter proposal below and authorize an exception with the following exact terms: 

1) Trial extension to 45 days total.
2) $25,000 platform credits applied during trial period.
3) 10% off list pricing for year-one on a signed 12-month reserved capacity commitment >= $150,000 ARR, executed within 60 days of credit grant.
4) If Aurora fails to execute the committed agreement within 60 days, unused credits will be invoiced at list and the discount voided (add rollback clause in SOW).
5) Legal to include DocuSign link and automated audit reporting for credit usage during trial (comms to procurement).

Kimberly — you have my sign-off to present this counter to Aurora and proceed with signature routing once they accept. Make sure procurement receives the SOW with the rollback clause and HubSpot is updated with the final terms (deal RDW-2026-AUR-47).

Marissa Cole
VP, Strategic Accounts
